codes.OAUTH_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: We can't sign you in: that account has no verified email address. Verify your email where you signed in, then try again.

codes.ATPROTO_BAD_CREDENTIALS: That handle and app password didn't check out. Make an app password in your account's settings and paste that one, not your main password.

codes.ATPROTO_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: That token took too long to show up, so we let it lapse. Start a new one.
codes.KEY_INVALID: That isn't a key we know how to read.
codes.KEY_BAD_SIGNATURE: That signature didn't check out. Sign the exact text we gave you and send it back.
codes.KEY_CHALLENGE_MISSING: There's no key sign-in waiting on you. Start one to get your text to sign.
codes.KEY_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: That key sign-in took too long, so we let it lapse. Start a new one.
codes.KEY_ALREADY_LINKED: That key already opens an account. Sign in with it instead.
codes.RETURNING_PLAYER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: That identity used to be somebody here. Say the word and we'll start you fresh.
